सिनेमा प्रेमियों के लिए एक बहुत बड़ी खबर आ गई है! 🎬

Denis Villeneuve की बहुचर्चित फिल्म Dune 3 सिनेमाघरों में 18 December 2026 को रिलीज होने के लिए तैयार है। इस आखिरी पार्ट में actor Robert Pattinson एक बेहद खतरनाक और रूप बदलने वाले विलेन Scytale के रोल में नजर आएंगे।

किताबों के अनुसार, Scytale असल में Bene Tleilax नाम की गुप्त सोसाइटी का Face Dancer है, जो दूसरों का रूप बदलकर Emperor Paul Atreides को गिराने की साजिश रचता है।

कहानी में Arrakis पहुंचकर वो अपने पूर्व सैनिक Farok और बच्चों की हत्या करता है। इसके बाद Lichina का रूप धरकर Paul के पास पहुंचता है और Chani की मौत के बाद Paul के दुख का फायदा उठाने की कोशिश करता है। हालांकि, दोनों के बीच हुई इस भयंकर भिड़ंत का अंत Scytale की मौत के साथ होता है। 😱

क्या आप Dune 3 में Robert Pattinson को इस खतरनाक अवतार में देखने के लिए एक्साइटेड हैं? कमेंट्स में जरूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.summary:
Who is Scytale in Dune 3? Discover the Face Dancer's powers, his connection to Duncan Idaho & Paul Atreides.  
 The post  Who is Scytale in Dune 3? Know Everything About Robert Pattinson’s Villain From The Franchise  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
The Dune franchise of Dennis Villeneuve is finally wrapping up with its last installment, Dune 3, which will hit the theatres on December 18, 2026. While the last installment is bringing back the major characters, Robert Pattinson’s Scytale is also not staying far.
Scytale in Dune 3 is the shapeshifting figure connected to Paul Atreides’ story. Compared to the other enemies of our protagonists, he is more powerful, and apparently, he doesn’t need to defeat Paul to get what he needs.
Given so much history, most newbie Dune fans have no idea who Scytale is or what makes him so dangerous. Well, there are some pretty disturbing answers in Frank Herbert’s Dune novels.
We first meet Scytale in the second Dune book by Frank Herbert, who belonged to the Bene Tleilax, which is a secretive religious society specializing in biological manipulation and genetic engineering. But the most unusual creation of the Bene Tleilax is the Face Dancer, which can impersonate others and change its appearance.
According to the books, Scytale is originally born as a Face Dancer in the Corrino Empire. Eventually, Scytale joins the conspiracy designed to bring down the then-new Emperor Paul Atreides. But Scytale’s true intentions towards Paul won’t end with his death.
The real conspiracy of Scytale, played by Robert Pattinson, begins when he travels as Bene Tleilax’s representative to Wallach IX and eventually makes his way to Arrakis. But one of the darker developments happens when he ends up murdering his former Freeman soldier named Farok along with the children.
Next, thanks to his face-altering abilities, he takes up Lichina’s appearance, pretends to be a young lady, and finally approaches Paul. All he wants is Bijaz’s arrival along with Paul’s death. While Bene Tleilax believes forcing the Hayt would work, he’s wrong.
Eventually, Duncan’s memories are recovered and restored. Later, when Chani dies in the booms while giving birth, her death pushes Paul in grief. And, Scytale takes advantage of this moment.
Although his plan seems quite lucrative initially, the condition is quite tragic when Paul is asked to compromise his newborn’s bodies to regain the love of his life. However, the confrontation between the duo ends with Scytale’s death. Must Read: TEXT
